newsitem.title: UK: OPTIONS-UK stocks thinly traded as caution sets in.
newsitem.headline: OPTIONS-UK stocks thinly traded as caution sets in.

text.p: Stock option deals trickled through on Wednesday afternoon as traders held off making large commitments while the UK stock market showed no preferred direction, dealers said.
In building materials group Blue Circle Industries the main deal was the sale of 500 May 420 calls at at 12-1/2p.

Dealers said this may have been a hedge to protect a holding of shares in Blue Circle if the underlying shares suffer a fall or a belief that the shares will not go above 420p by May expiry which will then make a maximum profit of 12-1/2p.
But if the calls were sold to hedge against a long stock position, the seller should be mildly bullish about the stock or believe it will trade in a narrow range.
There is then the risk that the shares will have to be sold if the stock price goes above 420p owing to the calls being assigned. By 1555 GMT, Blue Circle shares added 1p to 411-1/2p.

Similarly, in Centrica the gas supply company, the main deal was from a seller of 1,000 March 80 calls at 1/2p -- which because it involved far out-of-the-money options that expire in a couple of weeks -- may have been an attempt to capture the 1/2p time value still remaining with the options.

Over in tobacco-to-insurance group BAT Industries the chief deal was from a buyer of 250 July 500 puts at 29p. If this was an opening position it will make money if the underlying stock falls below 471p by expiry.
